recent_videos.title: Nvidia Gets Into the PC Market With New Chip | Bloomberg Tech 6/1/2026
recent_videos.thesis: Jensen Huang's Computex keynote re-ignites the AI trade on two fronts — Nvidia attacking the Intel/AMD PC market with an ARM-based RTX Spark CPU and arguing AI agents become software's biggest customers — while SpaceX's looming mega-IPO forces index providers to rewrite their rulebooks.

recent_videos.title: Anthropic's Digital God, Pope vs AI, Job Loss Narrative Flips, Open Source Crackdown Coming?
recent_videos.thesis: The besties and Bill Gurley argue that AI's real danger is centralization of power — whether via Anthropic's 'safety' branding driving regulatory capture or a government ban on open-source models — while the job-apocalypse narrative is collapsing into a story about high-agency adoption and corporate over-hiring.

recent_videos.title: SpaceX Lowers IPO Valuation Target | Bloomberg Tech 5/29/2026
recent_videos.thesis: A week of record AI-driven valuations — SpaceX trimming its IPO target to $1.8T, Anthropic eclipsing OpenAI at $965B, Dell's blowout server guide — tests whether investors are paying for present fundamentals or a decade-out dream, with Blue Origin's exploded rocket as a reminder the dream isn't guaranteed.

recent_videos.title: Inference, Diffusion, World Models, and More | YC Paper Club
recent_videos.thesis: Five researchers walk through frontier papers showing that the next gains in AI come less from bigger pretraining and more from rethinking the stack — parallelizing inference for capability, factorized diffusion world models for control, elegant anti-collapse regularizers, classical generalization theory, and trading infinite compute for scarce data.

recent_videos.title: SpaceX's $2T Case, Nvidia's Shock Selloff, America Turns on AI, Trump Pulls AI Order, Bond Crisis?
recent_videos.thesis: AI economics have flipped from speculative to undeniably profitable — Anthropic is EBIT-positive and SpaceX's S-1 reveals a $15B/yr compute-rental business — yet public sentiment, geopolitics, and a brewing bond crisis are turning into the real constraints on the boom.
